summary: The filing reports that loanDepot, Inc. entered into an at-the-market sales agreement with BTIG, LLC to sell up to $100 million of its Class A common stock from time to time. This is a routine equity shelf distribution facility, not a special situation. Proceeds will be used to reduce debt and for general corporate purposes. The shares are issued under an existing Form S-3 shelf registration. No board recommendation, premium, or structural complexity is involved. The filing is a standard establishment of an ATM program, analogous to a shelf takedown mechanism. There is no risk-arb angle; the event is ordinary-course financing.
